name: vllm-rocm-halo-main-wheel
description: vLLM upstream main wheel built from source on the InferStation pytorch-rocm-halo v2-staging base, packaged as a FROM-scratch image (the .whl + resolved ROCm/PyTorch constraints only). Compiled incrementally via a persistent ccache BuildKit cache mount. Consumed by the vllm-rocm-halo-main assembler to produce clean nightly images without recompiling. ABI-locked to (VLLM_TAG, VLLM_BASE, gfx1151, py3.12); rebuild when upstream main or the base image changes.
